detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Weather the storm with all the extras in the Against the Storm Supporter Pack:

  • An OST featuring 291 minutes of in-game music composed by Mikołaj Kurpios – including uncompressed WAV and lossless FLAC formats, as well as the option to enjoy the music using the Steam Soundtrack player

  • 11 4K wallpapers

  • 28 profile pictures for use across platforms

  • 50+ emojis to express yourself

  • 26 World Event illustrations

  • A 300+ page digital artbook with concept art spanning the entire development process and featuring unused ideas (only in English)

How to access the Supporter Pack

All Supporter Pack items can be found in Steam\steamapps\common\Against the Storm
